_comment1: This is an exemplary configuration template. Values aren't to be taken literally.

template._comment2: The relative or absolute path to the template document source.

output._comment3: The relative or absolute path to the destination folder.
output._comment4: The filename template array for concatenation.
output._comment5: Even-indexed (i.e. first, third, fifth, etc.) elements are literal text.
output._comment6: Odd-indexed (i.e. second, fourth, sixth, etc.) elements are placeholder names.
output._comment7: The WdSaveFormat index of the output file.

data._comment8: The relative or absolute path to the data worksheet source.
data._comment9: The name of the sheet containing data.
data._comment10: Placeholder names in the document and filename template mapped to their worksheet ranges.
